To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Cr 3 C2 has a significant impact on the microstructure of hard-facing alloy and its properties.
Cr 3 C2 has significant effects on the microstructure of the surface strengthened layer and the wear resistance of automobile molds.
the wear resistance increases with the increase in the Cr 3 C2 content, and the best wear resistance is achieved when the Cr 3C2 content is 5%.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the preparation of the hard-facing alloy with the high wear resistance, which can provide the theoretical basis for improving the service life of the automobile mold.
the microstructure and wear resistance of surface strengthening layer by submerged arc welding on automobile mold.
the preparation technology and mechanism of the high wear resistant hard-facing alloy, and the results can provide reference for the preparation of the high wear-resistant hard-facing alloy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the optimal content of Cr 3C 2 is 8% for hard facing of the die steel by flux cored wire submerged arc welding, which can be used to produce the automobile molds with good wear resistance and high surface quality.
when the content of Cr 3C 2 is 8%, a hard-facing layer with the optimal microstructure and properties can be obtained.
when Cr 3 C2 content is 6%～10%, the wear resistance of hard-facing alloy is best.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hard-facing alloy with 8% Cr 3 C2 content can be prepared on the surface to obtain a high wear-resistant surface layer.
the wear resistance can be improved by increasing the content of Cr 3C2 in the flux-cored wire, but the content of Cr3C 2 cannot be too high.
the hard-facing alloy with 8%Cr 3 C 3 content has the highest wear resistance and the best comprehensive properties.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of Cr 3C 2 can effectively improve the microstructure and mechanical properties of the surface strengthening layer.
it is feasible to improve the properties of hard-facing alloy by adjusting the content of Cr 3C2.
it is feasible to use Cr 3 C2 as the main carbide phase to prepare high wear-resistant surface strengthening layer on automobile mold.
